disclaimer: This tool helps organize information about attorneys families are considering. It does not evaluate, rank, or recommend any attorney. For legal advice, consult a licensed immigration attorney.
jurisdiction_note: Bar license verification is available through each state's bar association website. Families commonly check the relevant state bar's public directory before engaging an attorney.
no_attorneys: No attorneys added yet. Families commonly track attorneys they are considering in one place.

verification.title: Verification Checklist
verification.subtitle: Families commonly verify the following before engaging an attorney.
items: Bar license confirmed active with state bar association
No active disciplinary proceedings found
Confirmed practice includes immigration / removal defense
Office location and contact details verified
AILA membership status noted (optional)
Written fee agreement received before payment

questions.title: Questions Families May Choose to Ask
questions.subtitle: The following are questions families commonly find relevant when meeting with an attorney. Recording answers here helps with comparison.

experience.label: Experience
items: How many removal defense cases have you handled in the past two years?
Are you familiar with the immigration court that has jurisdiction in this matter?
Have you handled cases involving this country of origin?
Do you speak the relevant language, or do you work with a certified interpreter?

scope.label: Scope of Representation
items: What does the engagement cover — bond hearing, individual hearing, or both?
What is not included in the quoted scope?
Who at the firm will handle day-to-day work on this matter?
How will the family be notified of court dates and deadlines?

fees.label: Fees and Billing
items: What is the total estimated fee for the full scope of representation?
Is the fee flat-rate or hourly, and what triggers additional billing?
What is the payment schedule?
Under what conditions, if any, would the fee be refunded in whole or in part?

communication.label: Communication
items: How often does the attorney typically communicate updates to families?
What is the preferred channel for reaching the attorney or staff?
What is the typical response time for messages?
Who should the detained person contact directly if they have urgent questions?

documents.label: Documents and Records
items: What documents will the attorney need from the family?
How will documents be shared securely?
Who retains the case file if representation ends?
How long are records kept after the matter closes?

agreement.title: Written Agreement Checklist
agreement.subtitle: Families commonly review written retainer agreements for the following items before signing.
items: Attorney's full legal name and bar number are included
Scope of representation is clearly defined
Fee amount is stated in writing
Payment schedule and method are specified
Refund or termination policy is included
Confidentiality obligations are stated
Who handles the matter day-to-day is identified
Court jurisdiction and venue are specified
How the attorney will communicate with the family
What happens if the attorney leaves the firm
Client's right to a copy of the signed agreement is stated
Signatures of both parties are present

fee_phases.title: Fee Phases
fee_phases.subtitle: Families commonly ask attorneys to itemize fees by phase of the case. Entering phases here helps track what has been quoted and paid.
fee_phases.label: Phase label

fee_comparison.title: Fee Comparison
fee_comparison.subtitle: Side-by-side view of quoted fees across attorneys being considered. Figures shown are as recorded — no evaluation is made.
fee_comparison.no_data: Add fee phases for two or more attorneys to compare.

budget_planner.title: Budget Tracker
budget_planner.subtitle: Track total quoted fees, payments made, and remaining balance.
budget_planner.billing_note: Attorneys typically describe billing structures in their written agreements. Families commonly review these agreements carefully and keep copies of all receipts.

contact_log.title: Contact Log
contact_log.subtitle: Families commonly keep a record of all communications with their attorney.
